# Inspect scientific Python packages (python.packages)

## categories

[
  "code",
  "computation"
]

          "name": "open-lab-missing-package",
          "version": null
        }
      ]
    },
    "id": "missing-package",
    "input": {
      "names": [
        "open-lab-missing-package"
      ]
    },
    "title": "Unavailable distributions are reported explicitly, never installed."
  }
]

## description

Inspect installed distribution metadata without importing executable modules. Default names: numpy, scipy, sympy, mpmath, pandas, matplotlib, pillow. Optional names (at most 32) checks other distribution names; a null version means not installed. Does not install/download or grant any permission. Use python.run with help() for offline library docstrings; projects, computations, plots and raster images can be created and revised in your workspace.

  }
